_about: One place that assigns a model to every agent. runner: api = in-app call to the Anthropic API; cli = a Claude Code session started on the Mac by scripts/dispatcher.py; desktop = a desktop scheduled task on the Mac; code = no model. Models are named by tier and resolved in registry.py. Escalation happens only when a validation rule fails (schema, exact quote, required fields, numbers), never on a model's stated confidence. Changing a model here is an owner decision (ops/steward.md).

cv_extract.job: read an uploaded CV into requirement evidence

level.job: judge a posting's real level and scope with quotes

evidence.job: find CV lines that evidence a requirement

industry.job: classify companies by sector and size

sourcing.job: web search for postings the boards miss

matches.job: web search for postings on a user's request

company_facts.job: company dates and level ladders with sources

analyst.job: write the weekly brief from stored numbers

checker.job: review the brief against its data

ask.job: answer a user's question with the app's tools

job_discovery.job: read job boards, filter, dedupe, close vanished postings

peer_intake.job: request file; derive holders from collected files

hire_collector.job: read-only LinkedIn reads for open requests
hire_collector.note: model is set in the desktop app's task settings; it cannot be changed from the scheduling API

steward_audit.job: weekly audit of health status, code changes and backlog

council_reviewer.job: independent review of a change against the invariants

council_synth.job: reconcile a council; anything that changes a score or recommendation
